justification: New pure-logic serializer module with no DB writes, no external API calls, and no user-facing surface yet; it feeds a future LLM selection layer, so silent wrong output matters (standard, not low), but nothing here mutates production data (not critical).

pre_impl.existing_data: Consumes DevelopmentBrief/RenovationBrief pydantic models or their model_dump() dicts from services/intelligence_brief.py; reads nothing from the database directly.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a brief section stops following the DataField shape (value+confidence+source keys), the walker omits it fail-closed and records a warning in manifest.warnings rather than serving unprovenanced data.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies only at call time to whatever brief object is passed in; no stored rows are touched and no schema exists for manifests yet.
pre_impl.external_source_error: N/A — no external source is queried by this module.
pre_impl.frontend_type: N/A — no frontend consumer until PR-3.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: N/A — not user-facing in this PR.

functions.name: build_manifest
functions.input: DevelopmentBrief/RenovationBrief pydantic model or its model_dump dict from the brief pipeline
functions.output: BriefManifest with stable-ID field, gap and finding entries plus data hash
functions.if_none: Non-dict input raises TypeError at the gate; a None or missing section is simply skipped by the walker with the manifest still produced

functions.name: check_intent_compatibility
functions.input: brief model or dump dict plus a user intent enum value or string
functions.output: IntentCompatibility with four-state status, reason text and strata type
functions.if_none: Missing or failed strata classification returns UNKNOWN status with reason, never a silent COMPATIBLE green light

functions.name: _emit_datafield
functions.input: one DataField-shaped dict node plus its dotted path within the brief
functions.output: appends field rows or gap rows to the accumulator lists in place
functions.if_none: value None with reason becomes a GAP row; value None without reason becomes a queried-empty FIELD row keeping its confidence badge

functions.name: _walk
functions.input: arbitrary section subtree of the dumped brief with its dotted path
functions.output: recursively discovered DataField rows appended to field and gap accumulators
functions.if_none: scalar or non-walkable nodes are ignored by design because rows require DataField provenance

functions.name: _is_datafield
functions.input: any node encountered during the tree walk of the brief
functions.output: boolean, true only when value, confidence and source keys all present
functions.if_none: None or non-dict nodes return False so look-alike records cannot fabricate rows

functions.name: _enum_value
functions.input: possibly an Enum member from model_dump in default python mode
functions.output: the underlying enum value, or the input unchanged for non-enums
functions.if_none: None passes through unchanged and is handled by the caller's None path

functions.name: _render_value
functions.input: any present DataField value including lists of records and structs
functions.output: single-line pipe-safe text with explicit record counts and overflow markers
functions.if_none: empty list renders an explicit queried-empty marker instead of disappearing

functions.name: _summarise_record
functions.input: one record dict from a flattened decision-critical list
functions.output: compact key=value summary string over the record's scalar entries
functions.if_none: non-dict records fall back to scalar rendering; empty records render a no-detail marker

functions.name: _clip
functions.input: any rendered text destined for one manifest table row
functions.output: single-line text with pipes replaced and length capped with ellipsis
functions.if_none: callers never pass None; empty string returns empty string safely

functions.name: _data_hash
functions.input: the final ordered list of manifest entries after ID assignment
functions.output: sha256 hex digest excluding as_at so the hash tracks data changes only
functions.if_none: empty entry list hashes deterministically to the empty-canonical digest

functions.name: _collect_findings
functions.input: the dumped brief's compound_constraints and sepp_lep_overrides registers
functions.output: finding row dicts with severity and clipped description text
functions.if_none: missing or non-dict register entries are skipped without raising

functions.name: to_prompt_block
functions.input: the manifest's own ordered entries plus address and brief type header
functions.output: deterministic pipe table string consumed as the Stage-1 cached prompt block
functions.if_none: entries list empty still renders the two header lines deterministically

values.if_missing: empty string falls through to the is_strata fallback and an unrecognised non-empty type returns REVIEW, never silent COMPATIBLE
row omitted fail-closed and a warning recorded in manifest.warnings
no reason means legit-empty, rendered as a FIELD with its confidence badge preserved

break_it.scenario: Granny-flat intent requested for a strata apartment where the LLM previously composed a build plan anyway (live validation 2026-07-15)
break_it.what_happens: User would receive a feasibility-style overlay for a project the lot cannot legally pursue individually
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py:268 — apartment strata plus physical build intent returns INCOMPATIBLE deterministically before any LLM call

break_it.scenario: Upstream heuristic emits contradictory strata record with is_strata False but strata_type apartment
break_it.what_happens: Old ordering returned COMPATIBLE, silently disabling the exact guard this module exists to provide
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py:264 — strata_type comparison now outranks the is_strata boolean flag

break_it.scenario: Caller passes model_dump output where StrataType and ConfidenceLevel remain enum members on Python 3.11
break_it.what_happens: String comparison silently misses so the apartment guard downgrades and confidence badges render as ConfidenceLevel.AUTHORITATIVE
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py:389 — _enum_value unwraps members before comparison and rendering; killed live in mutation run

break_it.scenario: Legitimately empty control (queried, no height limit exists) conflated with a failed fetch
break_it.what_happens: A clear answer would render as a data gap, or worse a failure would render as checked-clear
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py:463 — three-state branch maps reason-present to GAP and reason-absent to queried-empty FIELD keeping confidence

break_it.scenario: Domain record carrying value and reason keys nested in a walked struct resembles a DataField
break_it.what_happens: A phantom GAP row appears for data that was never a gap, polluting rule-4 gap surfacing downstream
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py:401 — strict shape check requires value, confidence and source keys together

break_it.scenario: DCP control text containing a pipe character shifts the manifest table columns
break_it.what_happens: The LLM reads part of the value as the confidence column, corrupting citation rendering downstream
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py:557 — pipes replaced with slashes in every rendered cell; killed live in mutation run

break_it.scenario: Decision-critical SEPP or DCP list compacted to a bare record count as in the prototype
break_it.what_happens: Stage-1 selection cannot see the standards and skips the most relevant field for the user's stated intent
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py:495 — FLATTEN_LIST_PATHS emits one row per record; flatten-disable mutation killed live

break_it.scenario: Same data gap arrives from both the walked DataField and the brief-level gap register
break_it.what_happens: Duplicate gap rows waste tokens and make gap counts wrong, as observed in the live Concord manifest
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py:333 — register entries merge only when their field path was not already walked
